inspiration.observed_pattern: The public regression SQL exercises INSERT ... RETURNING together with INTERSECT ALL set-operation syntax.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Combine those constructs in an independently authored MariaDB fixture: intersect two deliberately duplicated label streams with INTERSECT ALL, insert the shared multiset into an auto-increment archive in deterministic order, and return each generated archive ID.

fixture_notes: The current stream contains alpha twice and beta once; the observed stream contains alpha three times and beta once. INTERSECT ALL retains alpha twice and beta once, while gamma and delta are excluded.
determinism_notes: All source labels and duplicate counts are fixed; the derived multiset is ordered by label before insertion, and returned/final rows are ordered by archive ID. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE current_labels (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, label_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE observed_labels (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, label_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE shared_label_archive (archive_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, label_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO shared_label_archive (label_name) SELECT shared.label_name FROM (SELECT label_name FROM current_labels INTERSECT ALL SELECT label_name FROM observed_labels) AS shared ORDER BY shared.label_name RETURNING archive_id, label_name
SELECT archive_id, label_name FROM shared_label_archive ORDER BY archive_id

checks.sql: SELECT label_id, label_name FROM current_labels ORDER BY label_id
SELECT label_id, label_name FROM observed_labels ORDER BY label_id
